candidateAiSha256Binding: must equal the hash recorded by the successful feature-off equivalence result

population.assignedPhaseBySourceOffsetParity: even source offset -> namua; odd source offset -> mtaji
population.rootEligibility: assigned-phase nonterminal state with at least two exact legal move variants
population.rootSelectionWithinTrajectory: minimum SHA-256 rank over measurementSpecId, assigned phase, seed, ply and strict RAW key

globalPopulationSelection.selection: minimum SHA-256 population rank within phase after one-root-per-trajectory materialization

runtimeEligible.definition: frozen baseline hard/enhanced/bao D3 completes and its actual nominal enhanced-search execution visits at least one depth-zero state that is nonterminal, opponent-to-root-player, and has exact legal move variant count == 1
runtimeEligible.selection: minimum SHA-256 eligible rank within phase, then deterministic minimum-rank fallback fill across remaining eligible roots if a phase cannot reach 64

negativeControl.definition: frozen baseline hard/enhanced/bao D3 completes and visits zero such single-reply opponent cutoff states
negativeControl.selection: minimum SHA-256 negative-control rank within phase, then deterministic fallback fill

strictRawIdentity.serialization: stable JSON object with exactly the frozen fields in listed order

reference.interpretation: engineering comparison reference only; not game-theoretic truth
reference.internalSearch: deterministic alpha-beta with frozen public evaluation and quiescence semantics, no TT dependence
reference.topSet: all root moves tied at maximum reference score
reference.canonicalTieBreak: ascending canonical move key only for deterministic presentation; TopSet remains tie-aware

metrics.topSetAgreement: 1 iff selected move key belongs to D4 reference TopSet
metrics.normalizedRankLoss: (reference scoreRank - 1) / max(1, legalMoveCount - 1), where scoreRank = 1 + number of candidates with strictly greater reference score
metrics.severeLoss: selected move is unique worst by D4 reference score OR selected move is root-loss-mate-domain while D4 best is not root-loss-mate-domain
metrics.catastrophicNewLoss: candidate severe loss while baseline is not severe AND candidate is immediate terminal loss or root-loss-mate-domain while at least one D4 reference candidate is not a loss
metrics.nodeRatio: candidate feature-on cumulative stats.nodes / baseline cumulative stats.nodes for the D3 analyzeMove call

cost.percentileMethod: nearest-rank on ascending finite node ratios
